Current Microsoft Windows/PowerShell task guidance supports manual task execution and explicit enable/disable control. Current .NET worker-service guidance confirms BackgroundService cancellation should drive graceful shutdown and that unhandled BackgroundService exceptions can stop the host. Talvora therefore keeps maintenance cancellation-aware and drains both Penpot child output streams continuously while the child remains alive instead of coupling log rotation to process restart.

Current Microsoft ScheduledTasks guidance documents Get-ScheduledTask plus explicit Start-ScheduledTask and Stop-ScheduledTask lifecycle operations.
